assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: full-body standing character art for an articulated 2D website dance.
Input image: the last full-body Xiaoxing illustration is the identity, outfit, materials and rendering REFERENCE. Generate the SAME young adult woman, recognizably the same face, purple eyes, silver-lavender wavy long hair with pink tips, gold star hairclip and sakura hair ornament, cream knit open cardigan with sakura buttons, purple ribbon choker, lavender belted floral dress with layered translucent ruffled hem, and exactly the same ivory ankle boots with lavender bows and gold charms.
Change her pose to STANDING, facing the camera, relaxed cheerful smile, head upright with a tiny natural tilt. Both feet stand separately at shoulder width, both knees straight but soft. Both arms extend diagonally OUT and DOWN about 35 degrees from the torso, elbows only slightly bent, palms facing the viewer, fingers naturally relaxed and clearly separated. There must be transparent gaps between both arms and the body, between both legs and between the hands and the skirt. Her hair stays BEHIND the shoulders and ends around the waist, with detailed loose waves. Her cream cardigan hem ends near the hips, above the skirt's lower ruffles; both upper legs are visible below the dress. Keep the modest dress length, flattering original proportions and original-level detailed face. No sitting, crossed legs, bent high heels, T-pose stiffness or chibi proportions.
Composition: centered single complete character, upright portrait 1024x1536, feet around 94% height, hair top around 4% height, arms fully inside the image with generous 6% side margin. Camera level, near-orthographic perspective; original soft 3D-rendered anime illustration quality and lighting. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. No moon, hand-held star, floor, ground shadow, pedestal, text, extra objects or other characters. Fine knitted fabric, silky detailed hair, soft natural shadows. This will be cut into skeletal layers, so keep every limb unoccluded and readable.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: hidden-part backplate for this exact standing Xiaoxing 2D dance puppet.
Input: the most recent standing full-body girl is the EDIT TARGET.
Preserve EXACT 1024x1536 canvas, pixel alignment, original standing head and face, hair, torso, floral dress, cardigan front panels, and lighting. Make only these removals:
1. Remove both ENTIRE arms and hands, including both cream cardigan sleeves, from just below the exposed shoulder caps out to every fingertip. Keep both bare shoulder caps and the cardigan's front body panels in place. Reconstruct the long lavender-pink hair and transparent gaps behind the removed sleeves.
2. Remove both legs and boots below the dress hem. Keep every ruffled dress edge intact and reconstruct the rear ruffles where the original legs covered them.
No replacement arms, hands, legs or boots. This is a hidden background plate; the original intact limbs will be drawn over it as articulated layers. Preserve all other pixels as closely as possible. Do not shift, zoom, change face, change pose, alter hem length, change costume or add decorations. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, including all now-empty arm and leg areas. No drop shadow, glow, dark background or text.
assets.registration: Generated plate is 1.25x larger around the upper center. Uniform 80% resize, centered horizontally, north-aligned to original 1024x1536; only hidden regions contribute.
